name: Rtx Gorilla Tag 2
summary: Step into the wildest game of tag you’ve ever seen, now reimagined with ultra-realistic graphics, cinematic lighting, and lifelike environments. RTX Gorilla Tag 2 isn’t just a visual upgrade—it’s a full-blown immersive evolution of the beloved Gorilla Tag gameplay, brought to life with cutting-edge ray tracing and next-gen rendering technology.
